intended_object: The linear map (⊗ˢ φ_a) ⊗ id_N : (ι → M)^{⊗s} ⊗ N → M^{⊗s} ⊗ N, where φ_a(v) = Σ_i a_i v_i (inferred from the docstring and the companion `scalarSum`). It is a proof-specific helper for `exists_nonzero_scalarSumTensor_annihilates`.
explanation: The body is `(PiTensorProduct.map (fun _ => scalarSum a)).rTensor N`, which matches the docstring exactly: apply the scalar sum Σ a_i π_i in every slot of the s-th tensor power, then tensor with id_N. This composite has no standard name in the literature. It is a bundled combination of Mathlib primitives that exists only to state and prove the annihilation lemma in the same file. That proof expands the map into homogeneous polynomials in a and applies a Chevalley–Warning-type common-zero result. So it is an auxiliary device rather than a standard mathematical object. As a formalization of its docstring it is correct.
